main_body: Wooden display base (rows 22-29) with a glass dome and tiered cake standing on it (rows 10-22)

evidence: In the x=16 column, the dome interior and cake run rows 10-21 as a vertical view. Row 22 is a 1px lip, row 23 is dark, and rows 24-29 are the brown front with inset drawer recesses. The base has no top surface; the 1px edge is a rim only. The dome and the cake tiers are side silhouettes, so the cake's tops are not seen from above. The whole thing reads as a front elevation with a thin lip, which fails the contract.

style.evidence: Outlines are tinted (0% neutral edge pixels). Median colours per tile (14) are close to the references (17 and 20), and flat-fill coverage is only 9%. But the piece has 19 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references. The glass is only about 3 steps (white, pale blue, mid blue), and the wood front is a flat mid-brown with a single dark recess line. Shading and texture are thinner than the stall and well references, which carry per-material grain and 5-6 steps.
